description: Sensitivity Factors (Import) is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction This dataset provides Sensitivity Factors (SFs) for UK Power Networks' three licence areas. SFs represent the marginal impact of a power injection at a node on the network to branches (lines or transformers) elsewhere. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Supporting Information. The portal shows 2024-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
